decision.reason: [ev-a228b19b23ac] is a single changelog line saying workload identity support for remote clusters was added. It does not say the feature is opt-in or that existing remote-cluster behaviour is unchanged, so the proposed statement that the note "states no change to existing behavior" claims more than the evidence says. To settle whether the consequence is "none", we need the description of PR #5434 or the matching docs saying whether the feature is opt-in and whether existing remote-cluster access is unchanged.
